Classes: `runtime` -- a resolved code fragment is an entry point of the station's package (a CLI verb module, an MCP tool module, a REST route or a portal view); `module` -- resolved code that is no named entry point, so the inventory cannot show a user reaches it (listed, never counted as unflagged); `planning` -- every `Surface:` fragment is a document (not reachable at runtime); `unresolved` -- no landed citing story, no `Surface:` line, or no code fragment resolves. The join is Doctor's (`pyforge.doctor.sources.capability_effect`): a CAP is joined to its code through the `Surface:` line of each story that cites it in `epics.md` (or on a story spec's `Parent:` line); only a landed story joins (its ledger key reads `done`), and the landed story whose `Surface:` classifies best wins. A Spec whose `## Capabilities` section lists no `- **CAP-N ...**` bullet declares none. The flag column names the key of a tracked story spec of this station that carries a `flag:` block and cites the Spec and CAP, or `exempt: <value> (<story key>)` for a retrofit story exempt under a value in the roster's `flag_retrofit_cover_exemptions` that cites the Spec and CAP (not counted as unflagged); `n/a` marks a row that is not `runtime`.
